test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

A boy died after he was __assaulted __by a teacher in his school.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guarded**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **Assaulted **means attacking physically.
 
• The word **Guarded **means being cautious , careful and having possible security.
 
• The meaning of word **Assaulted **is opposite of the meaning of word **Guarded**, *hence Guarded is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Scolded **means angrily remonstrate or rebuke

*Example *: My mother **scolded **me for being late.

 
• The word **Warned** means give (someone) a word of caution about their actions or behaviour.

*Example* : He **warned **me about being with that guy.

 
• The word **C****riticized **means expressing judgement.

*Example *: My teacher **criticized **me for wearing shorts.
